name: Shinnin Kyonyuu Jokyoushi Nana ~Owaranai Kounai Ryoujoku~
original_name: 新任巨乳女教師 奈々～終わらない校内凌辱～
source:
Nana is a new teacher at Tenga school.
"Just keep away from Koga Masao. Don't ever try to talk to him, " It is what a male teacher said to her at the end of orientation held in her first day at the school. But she is filled with a sense of mission to reclaim him from a life of vice.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE031004.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
娜娜是Tenga学校的新老师。
“离古贺正男远一点，永远不要试图和他说话，”这是她第一天到学校的迎新活动结束时，一位男老师对她说的。但她充满了使命感，要把他从罪恶的生活中拯救出来。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE031004.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
